+<!doctype html>
+<meta charset="utf-8">
+<title>Demo</title>
+<button id="go">Load</button>
+<script>
+document.getElementById('go').onclick = () => {
+  // Mission-critical: hint the browser to prioritize this request.
+  fetch('/api/data', { priority: 'high' })
+    .then(r => r.json())
+    .then(d => console.log(d))
+    .catch(console.error);
+
+  // Analytics: low priority so it doesn't compete with /api/data; keepalive lets it finish if the page unloads.
+  fetch('/api/analytics', {
+    method: 'POST',
+    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+    body: JSON.stringify({ click: 1 }),
+    priority: 'low',
+    keepalive: true
+  }).catch(console.error);
+};
+</script>
